import math

values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"Values: {values}")

print(f"Mean = {mean}")

# Theil index calculation

theil_sum = 0
for y in values:

    theil_sum += ratio * math.log(ratio)

theil_index = theil_sum / n
print(f"Theil index = {theil_index}")
print(f"Theil index (rounded to 3 decimal places) = {round(theil_index, 3)}")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for Rural Electrification Administration (1961-1970)
values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"Mean = {mean}")

# Theil index calculation
# T = (1/n) * Σ(y_i/μ * log(y_i/μ))
theil_sum = 0
for i, y in enumerate(values):
    ratio = y / mean
    term = ratio * math.log(ratio)
    theil_sum += term
    print(f"y_{i+1}={y}, ratio={ratio:.6f}, log(ratio)={math.log(ratio):.6f}, term={term:.6f}")

theil_index = theil_sum / n
print(f"\nTheil index = {theil_index}")
print(f"Theil index (rounded to 3 decimal places) = {round(theil_index, 3)}")
EOF
